basic_profile.bio: Having been a Redditor for over 7 years, I have developed a keen interest in history and strategy games, often sharing my insights on subreddits like r/history and r/MazeRunner. Based in the United Kingdom, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me flexible hours to engage with my diverse interests, from digital art to online trading. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings exploring new reading material and learning about different cultures, with a particular fascination for Central Asia lately. I dislike aggressive online behaviors and tend to avoid controversial threads. My online hours are typically late afternoons to midnight GMT.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in History and a passion for learning, I have spent countless hours researching various historical events and figures, which is reflected in my active participation in educational subreddits. My curiosity extends to self-taught skills in digital art and graphic design, often shared through my freelance projects.
